game_title: Code Reading Relay – Bone Valley Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Valley, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sand ranger ahead. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the camel pen by solving code steps involving predicted that move the sand ranger forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the camel pen first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Bone Valley'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
